{{Top}}
'''Assault vehicle''' was a general umbrella term for many forms of attack vehicles, with prefixes such as "[[Light assault vehicle|light]]," "[[Heavy assault vehicle|heavy]]," and "[[Ground assault vehicle|ground]]" being used either in general terms or when referring to specific kinds of assault vehicles. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] was known to use the catchall term [[Combat Assault Vehicle|combat assault vehicle]] when referring to many of their often-eclectic arsenal of combat vehicles.
